correctness.rationale: Signed-graph intersections of any subset of matching planes are projective linear spaces with one free scalar per bipartite graph component in every characteristic not two. Universal inclusion-exclusion produces Q_m(L) in Z[L]. Independent exact sign-balanced coordinate counting over every finite field of odd cardinality produces P_m(q), and infinitely many q imply Q_m=P_m as polynomials. All zeta factors follow by extension-field counts. Four standalone checks succeeded, including complete 2^15-1 intersection-subset enumeration for m=3 and independent finite-field projective point counts; the proof, not finite tests, covers all dimensions.

value.rationale: The reduced union of canonical maximal-dimensional linear spaces is a geometrically motivated subvariety of Fermat cubic hypersurfaces. Its Grothendieck class is a natural exact invariant. A single structural generating identity calculates that class in every dimension over every allowed field, and all zeta functions over finite fields. This is a complete invariant of a natural infinite family, not a small-field lookup, arbitrary numerical slice, or mere rephrasing of a previously stated 15-plane configuration.
